`legacy-v1.html` is the exact output of `builder.Render` at PR143 head
`5647469a767922a866f7236cee8c742dd4cb0911` for `legacy-v1.json`.
It was generated by a temporary test in a separate archive of that commit,
not by the new renderer. The fixture includes hidden/blank headings, a hero
scene, image/button escaping, repeated cards/pricing, FAQ and a post feed.
`TestLegacyVersionOneRenderIsByteIdentical` guards the unchanged legacy path.
